en_title: Epic Reportedly Pushing Devs to Use AI, Delays Secret Star Wars and Marvel Crossover Shooter
cn_title: 《星球大战》Epic据报推AI开发，联动射击作延期
subtitle: 不再手写代码
opus_summary: 据彭博社报道，Epic推动AI优先开发，未公布的《星球大战》与漫威联动射击作延期。项目低估所需时间和资源，进度不及预期，新发售安排尚未公开。

paragraphs.en: Epic Games has reportedly delayed its secret Star Wars and Marvel crossover shooter as it pushes its developers to shift to an "AI first" production model.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，Epic Games在推动开发者转向「AI优先」制作模式的同时，推迟了尚未公开的《星球大战》与漫威联动射击游戏。

paragraphs.en: Details on the yet-to-be-announced Disney video game were shared by Bloomberg today. The site's report stated the untitled crossover experience was slated for release in March, but has since been pushed back to accommodate a new internal release plan that has yet to be shared.
paragraphs.cn: 彭博社今天披露了这款尚未公布的迪士尼游戏的细节。报道称，这款尚未定名的联动游戏原定于3月发售，但为了配合新的内部发售计划，现已延期。新计划尚未公开。

paragraphs.en: Epic developers attached to the project have reportedly been encouraged to use tools such as Anthropic's AI assistant, Claude, with humans expected to oversee that work. Bloomberg also obtained an internal message shared by one of the Star Wars/Marvel game's directors.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，Epic鼓励参与该项目的开发者使用Anthropic旗下AI助手Claude等工具，并要求由人类监督这些工具完成的工作。彭博社还获得了这款《星球大战》与漫威联动游戏的一位总监发布的内部消息。

paragraphs.en: "No more hand-written code,” an excerpt from the message said. The same message is then said to have added that all art for the project was to be "generated with full AI workflows."
paragraphs.cn: 消息中的一段写道：「不再手写代码。」据称，同一条消息还要求，项目中的所有美术内容都要「通过完全由AI完成的工作流程生成」。

paragraphs.en: The report continued, stating that Epic underestimated the time and resources necessary to develop the Star Wars and Marvel shooter. Progress has been slower than expected, leading to the delay. When and where it will launch is unclear.
paragraphs.cn: 报道还称，Epic低估了开发这款《星球大战》与漫威联动射击游戏所需的时间和资源。开发进度慢于预期，导致游戏延期。目前尚不清楚游戏何时发售、登陆哪些平台。

paragraphs.en: "We’re embracing AI-accelerated development, led by Epic developers who are the visionaries and creative drivers for everything we do," Epic communications director Jake Jones told Bloomberg in a statement.
paragraphs.cn: Epic传播总监Jake Jones在向彭博社提供的声明中表示：「我们正在拥抱AI加速开发，由Epic开发者主导。我们所做的一切，其愿景和创意都来自这些开发者。」

paragraphs.en: The site added that Epic's push for what appears to be a project that leans heavily on AI left many of its developers "stunned." News of the Star Wars and Marvel shooter's schedule change follows another Bloomberg report from earlier this year, which stated that Epic was working on an extraction shooter featuring Disney characters . It was said to be similar to Embark Studios' Arc Raiders at the time.
paragraphs.cn: 彭博社还称，Epic推动这个似乎高度依赖AI的项目，让许多开发者感到「震惊」。在这款《星球大战》与漫威联动射击游戏调整档期的消息传出之前，彭博社曾在今年早些时候报道，Epic正在开发一款包含迪士尼角色的撤离射击游戏。当时的报道表示，该作与Embark Studios的《Arc Raiders》类似。

paragraphs.en: Just moments before news of Epic's AI push broke, studio founder and CEO Tim Sweeney published a post on X/Twitter saying that the studio has a "huge pivot underway." He added that they are "moving developers around to retool for maximum AI acceleration."
paragraphs.cn: 就在Epic推动AI开发的消息传出前不久，公司创始人兼首席执行官蒂姆·斯维尼在X上发文，表示公司正在「推进重大转型」。他还称，公司正在「调整开发者的岗位，重新配置工具，以最大限度地利用AI加速开发」。

paragraphs.en: "The aim isn't to do the same stuff with fewer people," he continued, "but to enable everyone here to build MORE and BETTER stuff, and to bring the benefits to all teams using Unreal." In a follow-up post, Sweeney said , "Our more modest aim is to survive the AI revolution, help other developers do the same, and come out on the other end making better code and content faster."
paragraphs.cn: 他接着说：「目标不是用更少的人做同样的东西，而是让这里的每个人都能做出更多、更好的东西，并让所有使用虚幻引擎的团队受益。」斯维尼在后续帖子中表示：「我们更务实的目标是在AI革命中生存下来，帮助其他开发者也做到这一点，并在经历这场变革后，更快地写出更好的代码、制作更好的内容。」

paragraphs.en: "The biggest change will be much faster time from having an idea to playtesting it," he said in another post. "This will be great for gameplay, as most of the recent AAA failures can be attributed to game systems going through far too much of their development process without being able to playtest."
paragraphs.cn: 他在另一条帖子中表示：「最大的变化是，从产生想法到实际试玩测试，所需的时间将大幅缩短。这对玩法会很有帮助，因为近期大多数3A游戏的失败，都可以归因于游戏系统在开发过程中有太长一段时间无法接受试玩测试。」

paragraphs.en: Disney purchased a $1.5 billion stake in the Fortnite developer in 2024 in a move that cemented their relationship at the time. Outside of more crossovers within Epic's still-popular battle royale-centered video game, it seems we've yet to see the extent of their collaborations. Meanwhile, Disney recently refuted claims that it was interested in outright acquiring the game studio .
paragraphs.cn: 迪士尼于2024年斥资15亿美元(约合人民币100亿元)入股《堡垒之夜》开发商，巩固了双方当时的合作关系。除了在Epic这款依然热门、以大逃杀玩法为核心的游戏中推出更多联动，我们似乎还未看到双方合作的全貌。与此同时，迪士尼近日否认了其有意全面收购这家游戏公司的说法。
